blocks.name: plant
blocks.description: Dispatch hot and chilled water demand to the heat pump, boiler and chiller.

blocks.name: one
blocks.notes: Represents 100% of the heating or cooling request.

blocks.name: backup_fraction
blocks.notes: Calculates the share left for boiler and chiller after heat pump allocation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of hot-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of chilled-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: boiler
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining hot-water demand with the boiler.

blocks.name: chiller
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining chilled-water demand with the chiller.
Shared four-pipe plant: the heat pump serves a configurable fraction of heating and cooling demand; boiler and chiller cover the remainder.

blocks.name: ahu_1
blocks.description: Supply air temperature reset and fan speed control.

blocks.name: cold_threshold
blocks.notes: Below 12 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its warm-up supply temperature.

blocks.name: warm_threshold
blocks.notes: Above 25 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its cooling supply temperature.

blocks.name: warmup_supply
blocks.notes: 18 °C supply air is selected in cold weather.

blocks.name: mild_supply
blocks.notes: 16 °C supply air is selected in mild weather.

blocks.name: cooling_supply
blocks.notes: 14 °C supply air is selected in warm weather.

blocks.name: is_cold
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the cold-weather threshold.

blocks.name: is_mild
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the warm-weather threshold.

blocks.name: mild_or_cool
blocks.notes: Selects 16 °C or 14 °C supply air for mild or warm weather.

blocks.name: supply_reset
blocks.notes: Selects warm-up supply air in cold weather; otherwise uses the mild/warm result.

blocks.name: fan_gain
blocks.notes: Converts aggregate airflow request into a fan speed command.

blocks.name: fan_limit
blocks.notes: Zero minimum fan command permits shutdown when all zone airflow requests fall to zero.

blocks.name: minimum_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Minimum outdoor-air share for this teaching model.

blocks.name: free_cooling_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Higher outdoor-air share when free cooling is useful.

blocks.name: economizer_low_limit
blocks.notes: Avoid high outdoor-air intake below 6 °C in this simplified model.

blocks.name: outdoor_below_return
blocks.notes: Outdoor air can cool the return air.

blocks.name: return_above_supply_target
blocks.notes: The AHU calls for cooling relative to return air.

blocks.name: outdoor_above_low_limit
blocks.notes: Avoid low-temperature economizer operation.

blocks.name: outdoor_above_supply_target
blocks.notes: Avoid high outdoor-air intake that would require heating.

blocks.name: free_cooling_useful
blocks.notes: Temperature conditions allow free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_temperature_ok
blocks.notes: Outdoor air stays above the low limit and supply target.

blocks.name: economizer_enabled
blocks.notes: Enable the higher outdoor-air share when all conditions hold.

blocks.name: outdoor_air_select
blocks.notes: Select the outdoor-air mixing fraction.

Serves five VAV zones. Outdoor temperature chooses the supply air target; total airflow request sets the supply fan speed. An editable temperature enable sequence selects 20% or 80% outdoor air for the physical mixing box.

blocks.name: zone_01
blocks.description: G36-style zone setpoint and minimum-airflow reset with local occupancy sensing.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint
blocks.notes: G36 occupied cooling setpoint: 24 °C.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint
blocks.notes: G36 occupied heating setpoint: 21 °C.

blocks.name: cool_deadband
blocks.notes: Cooling starts only after the room exceeds its setpoint by 0.5 °C.

blocks.name: zero
blocks.notes: Shared zero signal for disabled reheat and the heating-mode comparison.

blocks.name: minimum_damper
blocks.notes: Keeps the damper at least 15% open for ventilation.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow
blocks.notes: Base airflow estimate before pressure and damper effects are added.

blocks.name: cool_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is warmer than the cooling setpoint.

blocks.name: heat_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is colder than the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: cooling_mode
blocks.notes: Checks whether cooling error exceeds the 0.5 °C deadband.

blocks.name: heating_mode
blocks.notes: Enables reheat only when room temperature is below the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: air_can_cool
blocks.notes: Checks that supply air is cooler than the room before opening for cooling.

blocks.name: cooling_enabled
blocks.notes: Both a warm room and useful cool supply air are required to open the damper.

blocks.name: cool_pi
blocks.notes: PI loop turns room temperature error into a damper increment, capped at 85%.

blocks.name: heat_pi
blocks.notes: Reverse-acting PI loop turns low room temperature into a reheat command.

blocks.name: damper_offset
blocks.notes: Adds the minimum ventilation position to the cooling PI command.

blocks.name: damper_limit
blocks.notes: Clamps the requested damper position to 15–100%.

blocks.name: damper_select
blocks.notes: Uses the cooling damper request when cooling is enabled; otherwise holds minimum ventilation.

blocks.name: reheat_select
blocks.notes: Passes the heating PI command only in heating mode; otherwise closes reheat.

blocks.name: flow_span
blocks.notes: Scales the damper command into the variable part of the airflow estimate.

blocks.name: pressure_effect
blocks.notes: Reduces estimated flow when duct pressure is low.

blocks.name: airflow_sum
blocks.notes: Adds minimum airflow to the pressure-adjusted variable flow.

blocks.name: airflow_request_sum
blocks.notes: Adds minimum airflow to the damper request before pressure effects; this demand drives the AHU fan.

blocks.name: cool_demand_gain
blocks.notes: Converts positive cooling error into a normalized plant request.

blocks.name: heat_demand_gain
blocks.notes: Converts positive heating error into a normalized plant request.

blocks.name: cool_demand_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps zone cooling demand between zero and one.

blocks.name: heat_demand_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps zone heating demand between zero and one.

blocks.name: standby_cool
blocks.notes: Occupied standby cooling setpoint after five minutes vacant.

blocks.name: standby_heat
blocks.notes: Occupied standby heating setpoint after five minutes vacant.

blocks.name: unoccupied_cool
blocks.notes: G36 unoccupied cooling setback setpoint.

blocks.name: unoccupied_heat
blocks.notes: G36 unoccupied heating setback setpoint.

blocks.name: standby_damper
blocks.notes: Reduced occupied standby ventilation minimum.

blocks.name: unoccupied_damper
blocks.notes: No ventilation minimum outside occupied schedule.

blocks.name: standby_airflow
blocks.notes: Reduced occupied standby airflow minimum.

blocks.name: unoccupied_airflow
blocks.notes: No minimum airflow outside occupied schedule.

blocks.name: conditioning_mode
blocks.notes: Request occupied temperature setpoints during the schedule or the preconditioning window.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_heating
blocks.notes: Preserve minimum discharge airflow during a heating call.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_heating
blocks.notes: Preserve minimum discharge airflow during a heating call.

The scheduled mode uses occupied 21/24 °C setpoints. Five minutes without a person widens both setpoints by 0.5 K and reduces ventilation minimums; one minute of presence restores them. Outside the occupied schedule, the zone uses 16/32 °C setpoints and zero ventilation minimum. Before occupancy, preconditioning restores occupied temperature setpoints but keeps the reduced ventilation minimum. Heating mode preserves a minimum airflow path. The sensor debounce is performed by the simulation input, while these switches are CDL blocks.

The scheduled mode uses occupied 21/24 °C setpoints. Five minutes without a person widens both setpoints by 0.5 K and reduces ventilation minimums; one minute of presence restores them. Outside the occupied schedule, the zone uses 16/32 °C setpoints and zero ventilation minimum. Before occupancy, preconditioning restores occupied temperature setpoints but keeps the reduced ventilation minimum. Heating mode preserves a minimum airflow path. The sensor debounce is performed by the simulation input, while these switches are CDL blocks.

notes: Compare this sample with FourPipeBuildingControls using the same weather, equipment, and physical model. Each zone has a debounced Brick occupancy sensor. Occupied setpoints are 21/24 °C, standby widens them by 0.5 K, and unoccupied setpoints are 16/32 °C. Ventilation minimums and AHU fan minimums also reset. A six-hour preconditioning window requests occupied temperature setpoints before scheduled occupancy. The AHUs use outdoor/return temperature comparisons to enable a simplified free-cooling mode. This is a G36-inspired subset; trim-and-respond, modulating economizer, alarms, and CO2 sequences are not modeled.
